jobs_results.title: REACT + PYTHON DEVELOPER (HÍBRIDO)
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

Empresa, TALLERS SERRA, S.L. fabricante de maquinaria industrial para el sector del cartón ondulado, ubicada en Martorell, está buscando un React + Python Developer con experiencia en Django y React para trabajar en el desarrollo de la interfaz gráfica de un producto de visión artificial que se vende a clientes.

Como React + Python Developer, serás responsable de mantener el código y ampliar sus funcionalidades. Desarrollarás un sistema SCADA para plantas de cartón.

Ofrecemos la posibilidad de trabajar en una empresa en pleno crecimiento a nivel nacional e internacional, donde podrás participar en diferentes proyectos que te permitan continuar con tu desarrollo profesional.

Gozarás de un alto nivel de autonomía y se espera que seas resolutivo en tu tarea y comunicativo con tus resultados.

Funciones
• Desarrollar la interfaz gráfica de un producto SCADA utilizando Python y React.
• Estructurar el código y documentar su funcionamiento en markdown o wiki.
• Programar en... Django APIs para conectar la web con servicios y sistemas.
• Desarrollo e implementación de sistema de optimización con árbol de decisiones (tipo ajedrez).

Requisitos

Requisitos mínimos
• Grado en Ingeniería Informática o equivalente.
• Conocimientos avanzados en Django y React.
• Conocimientos en MySQL y MariaBD
• Experiencia en desarrollo de interfaces de usuario y conocimientos en HTML5, CSS3 y JavaScript.
• Conocimiento de patrones de diseño y buenas prácticas de desarrollo de software.
• Capacidad de organización, autonomía en la toma de decisiones y creatividad para encontrar soluciones.
• Experiencia demostrable liderando concepción, diseño, implementación, pruebas y despliegue de un proyecto con total autonomía.
• Residencia próxima a Martorell.

Requisitos adicionales valorables
• Experiencia en resolución de bugs y estructuración y documentación del código.
• Experiencia en la creación de un servidor de licencias.
• Experiencia en el sector de maquinaria industrial
• Conocimientos en Visión Artificial.
• Conocimientos Ingeniería automática, robótica industrial.
• Conocimientos de programación de PLC’s (Rockwell y/o Siemens).
• Conocimientos de PyQt5.
• Programación de pantallas táctiles (HMI) Siemens.
• Programación de robots KUKA.
• Diseño y programación de bus de comunicaciones industriales.
• Adaptación al cambio y flexibilidad
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo
• Incorporación Inmediata

Prestaciones
• Horario flexible
• Modalidad de trabajo híbrido
• Plaza de aparcamiento

Horario

Jornada laboral completa de 40 horas semanales, distribuidas de la siguiente manera:
• Lunes a jueves: 07:30 a 13:30 y 14:15 a 17:00 h.
• Viernes: 07:30 a 13:45 h

jobs_results.title: Python Developer (International Cybersecurity Project)
jobs_results.description:
Hello! 👋

We know that you are looking for a new challenge, yes, don't deny it, you are exploring new projects, offers and companies, therefore, something you would like to change🤭.

Who are we?

First of all, people are the most important value for us, secondly, we are people who love technology 💙🦾, we are tekkies, we like it, even if it has nothing to do with our job, those geeky novelties that make us spend hours watching on youtube, twitch, tik tok, GitLab or whatever.

We are a leading consultancy firm in the technology sector with national and international clients. This year is our 30th year of existence, with a 30% growth in our turnover and more than 2,500 people in our team. We are a different company, a company where people come first and where meritocracy prevails.

knowmad mood is Microsoft Gold Partner with 5 competencies:

- Gold Application Development

- Gold Cloud Platform

- Gold Application Integration

- Silver DevOps

- Silver Data Analytics

What are we... looking for?

The company is seeking an experienced Software Engineer with cybersecurity, Generative AI, and Python development expertise. This critical role involves designing and implementing systems to enhance the capabilities of cybersecurity professionals.

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to developing cutting-edge Generative AI systems to enhance the capabilities of cybersecurity analysts.
• Write secure efficient and scalable Python code from design to production in cloud native product.
• Contributing to technological and architectural decisions with the ability to take a leading role.
• Collaborate with interdisciplinary and remotely distributed teams, promoting a culture of technical excellence and innovation in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.
• Stay updated on the latest cybersecurity threats and technological advancements, ensuring our solutions are fortified against emerging threats.

Nice to have:
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in software development with an emphasis on cybersecurity and Generative AI.
• Mastery in Python programming (Django).
• Experience with CI/CD/DevOps, Git.
• Comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat modeling, and secure coding practices.
• Experience in developing secure applications with cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)>
• Experience with API development and integration, particularly cyber security products (SIEM, EDR, etc.)
• A Bachelor's or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field is preferred.

⏰ Full Time Position (Spain: 12:00h - 19:00h Aprox. GMT+1)

Going to work is not just about looking at emails and dealing with requests. Can you imagine doing a virtual escape room with your colleagues or joining a chess club? Throughout the year we do 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 activities for all. 🎮♟

If you have a friend you can't get rid of, get them to join us! If you think you fit any of our profiles and join us you will get a prize 🤑 🤑 🤑.

And if all this is not enough for you, we have many surprises that we are carrying out throughout the year.

Are you ready to face new challenges?

Join our more than 2,500 professionals and become part of a nice story in knowmad mood

jobs_results.title: Senior Observability Platform Developer - Python/Go
jobs_results.description:
Canonical seeks an experienced developer with a proven track record in Python and/or Go. As part of the Observability team, you will develop a cloud-native monitoring stack that composes best-in-class open-source monitoring tools. The stack is opinionated, resilient, and scalable, providing deep insights out of the box. The user experience is polished and seamless for the end-users, and its administrators will enjoy smooth, lightweight Day 1 and Day 2 operations.

This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

The monitoring stack will monitor applications running on a mix of cloud technologies such as Kubernetes and OpenStack, as well as bare-metal, virtual machines and containers. The stack will be capable of monitoring applications... and infrastructure irrespective of whether they are operated by Juju, and will leverage multiple data sources at various levels of the architecture, including Juju itself, to contextualize the collected telemetry and insights delivered to the end-users.

You can read more about the project here and here.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions

What your day will look like
• Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
• Write, test and document high quality code to create new features
• Debug issues and interact with a vibrant community
• Review code produced by other engineers
• Attend conferences to represent Canonical and the Charmed Observability Stack
• Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you
• You love technology, observability and working with brilliant people
• You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated

jobs_results.title: Staff Python Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Engineering team builds the software powering Veriff. We're cracking the online identity crisis in a scalable way, deploying excellence to keep Veriff on the cusp of innovation. It's a fast-paced market with many challenges. We're seeking an experienced team member to join our Verification Automation team as a Senior Python Engineer.

As a part of our Verification Automation team at Veriff, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving our real-time Verification Platform, focusing on critical aspects like security, scalability, and maintainability. Your role is crucial in designing and developing new systems that support Veriff's vision to build trust online through a reliable and user-friendly Identity Verification Platform.

You’ll Help Us Protect Honest People Online By
• Taking charge of the design, documentation, and validation processes for product and system development, ensuring top-notch quality and innovation
• Building, testing, and maintaining our automation... services using Python, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of our platform
• Working closely with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and machine learning experts, both within and outside the team, to tackle complex challenges and drive forward our vision for identity verification
• Owning and nurturing cross-functional partnerships, including working with dependency engineering teams and product stakeholders, to align goals and strategies
• Mentoring and guiding the team, ensuring they are well-equipped with the necessary skills and aligned with our mission

You are the right future Veriffian for the job if you have
• Over 5 years of experience building large-scale applications with Python
• A strong understanding of modular design approaches and SOLID principles, particularly in distributed systems
• Hands-on experience with building scalable and maintainable APIs and message-queuing concepts
• Proficiency in various test strategies, ensuring robust and reliable software solutions.
• Solid understanding of fundamental relational database concepts
• Familiarity with structured logging systems
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate and motivate technical ideas to both engineers and non-engineers

You can get familiar with our tech stack on StackShare.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team and offices in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...
• Flexibility to work from home
• Stock options that ensure your share in our success
• Comprehensive relocation support
• Extensive medical, wellness coverage to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
• Learning and Development budget that you are free to tailor for your own needs
• Six weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 3rd work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process we may request you to go through identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Policy.

#TBT
